caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate urn or vase centered on a plain, light beige background. The urn is rendered in black and grey tones and features intricate detailing. It has a wide, shallow bowl with a scalloped edge and sits on a short, fluted stem attached to a square base. On each side of the bowl, there are large, symmetrical handles with elaborate scrolling and floral ornamentation. The object appears to be metallic, suggested by the shading and texture. The composition is minimal, with the urn occupying the central portion of the page and no other elements or decorations present in the surrounding space.
title: Urn for Flowers
